codeReview.summary: The harness change now reads the canonical env accessor, exposes deterministic missing-secret guidance, and keeps the generated CTA on the canonical `/bookings/recover` path that strips tokens before landing on the booking detail URL. Added tests cover both configured-secret and missing-secret harness states, and the reviewed implementation matches the assigned feature scope.

sharedStateObservations.evidence: `src/app/(public)/dev/booking-recovery/page.tsx:32` uses `env.security.sessionRecoveryAccessTokenSecret`, while `src/app/(public)/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx:49-64` still reads `process.env.SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET?.trim()` before creating continuation tokens.
